_comment: User-facing changelog — surfaces feature-level updates inside the app. Newest first. Keep entries focused on things users care about (new features, template additions, UX improvements). Skip internal refactors, dep bumps, CI plumbing.

entries.title: Invite clients with a magic link
items: Magic link login — generate a one-time URL from the clients list and paste it into WhatsApp or email; your client signs in without a password.
Copy a sharable demo URL from any client card — preview their site before they pay.
Clients can now update their own contact email and phone from the portal.
DH Platform marketing site is now on its own Cloudflare project — independent deploys, ready for digitalhands.in.

entries.title: Choose your template — CV, Spa, Salon, or Yoga
items: DH Beaver now leads with a CV / Portfolio template — the fastest way to publish a personal site.
Three more templates available: Spa & Wellness, Hair Salon, Yoga Studio.
New clients can pick their template at signup; existing clients keep their current one.
Coming soon: AI-assisted content suggestions for your hero, bio, and services.

entries.title: Your edits now sync across devices
items: Save once in the admin editor — changes appear on your live site immediately, on any browser.
Sign in works from any device; sessions stay alive for 7 days.
If our backend is unreachable, edits still save locally and sync automatically when you're back online.

entries.title: Welcome to DH Beaver
items: Live admin editor: edit your brand, services, team, pricing, and theme without writing code.
Mobile-friendly responsive site templates with a polished default design.
Client portal so your customers can view their site stats and request changes.
